title: Product Appeal Audit Spec
description: Structured, already-scored input for scripts/appeal_audit.mjs. Every field is a number or boolean the analyst decided during the Analysis Process in SKILL.md; the auditor never inspects free text, images, or URLs itself.

personas.description: One entry per target persona, each with the Desirability Triangle sub-scores from the Analysis Process (Step 2).

fiveSecondTest.description: Whether each of the 5-Second Test's four questions was clear within ~5 seconds (SKILL.md 'Quick Analysis: The 5-Second Test').

category.description: Visitor could identify what this is.

forWho.description: Visitor could identify who it's for.

promise.description: Visitor could identify the core promise.

cta.description: Visitor could identify what to do next.

objectionsAddressed.description: Whether each standard objection type from the Objection Map (Step 3) is addressed on the page.

trustLadderViolation.description: True if the page asks for account creation/payment before demonstrating value (Trust Ladder Violation anti-pattern).

identityMismatch.description: True if the analyst judges the page tries to visually/verbally appeal to too many distinct identities, independent of persona count.

featureSoupHeadline.description: True if the headline lists 3+ capabilities/buzzwords instead of one outcome (Feature Soup Headline anti-pattern).

screenshotHero.description: True if the hero image is a bare product screenshot with no outcome/context (Screenshot Hero anti-pattern).
